fields.label: GCP Project ID
fields.description: The Google Cloud project containing the BigQuery datasets.

fields.label: Default dataset
fields.description: Optional default dataset for unqualified table references.

fields.label: Dashboard tickets table
fields.description: Optional fully-qualified BigQuery table (dataset.table) backing the ticket-dashboard cards. When set, also export BIGQUERY_DASHBOARD_TABLE in the agent container environment with the same value so the CLI can read it at runtime.

fields.label: Service account JSON key
fields.description: Optional GCP service account JSON key. Leave empty on GCE or other environments where Application Default Credentials are available.
